name: Doom Design System
description: AI skills, agents, hooks, and commands for the Doom Design System, a neubrutalist React component library. Gives AI agents deep knowledge of every component's API, A2UI protocol, design tokens, and coding standards.
longDescription:
Ships **1 skill**, **4 agents**, **3 commands** and **1 hook**.

- **Skills** (1): `doom-design-system` (AI skills and context for the Doom Design System — neubrutalist React component library)
- **Agents** (4): `a2ui-builder` (Generates valid A2UI JSON from natural language UI descriptions), `accessibility-reviewer` (Audits Doom Design System components for WCAG 2.1 AAA accessibility compliance), `component-builder` (Scaffolds a complete new Doom Design System component from scratch), `theme-builder` (Creates a complete new Doom Design System theme by generating CSS variable overrides for all design tokens)
- **Commands** (3): `a2ui` (Generates A2UI JSON from a natural language UI description), `doom-review` (Runs an accessibility audit on one or more components), `new-component` (Scaffolds a complete new Doom Design System component)
- **Hooks** (1): `PreToolUse`

Installs with `claude plugin install doom-design-system@claude-community` from `ornelasEduardo/doom`.
